fusions.name: Weak Tincture
fusions.desc: Squirts thinned venom that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. 30% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Lanced Clean
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. The lancing deals 18 damage and draws out every affliction you have on the target: 1.5 times their remaining damage is added to the blow and they are used up.

fusions.name: Milker's Immunity
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and restores 12 health to you.

fusions.name: No Cure for Yours
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 12% poison resistance.
